title: Microsoft Abandons Another AI Character: Copilot's Yellow Monster Mico Retires and Transfers to Learning Platform
excerpt: Microsoft announced that Mico, the yellow blob that makes expressions in Copilot's voice mode, will no longer appear in the chat interface. According to a Micro
content_html:
Microsoft announced that Mico, the yellow blob that makes expressions in Copilot's voice mode, will no longer appear in the chat interface. According to a Microsoft support page, Mico will be moved to the Learn Live learning platform, allowing this virtual character to "have more content to react to." This change was first reported by GeekWire.

Mico was launched in Copilot's voice mode last October, less than a year ago. At that time, Microsoft's AI business CEO Mustafa Suleiman presented it as an attempt to give the chatbot a "sense of identity," with this little blob making expressions and animations in real-time based on user conversations. Now, its departure adds it to the list of virtual assistants Microsoft has cut over the years — from Clippy, the paperclip, to voice assistant Cortana and search dog Rover, none of which have escaped.

"Learning" Consolidation, Imminent

Microsoft wrote on its support page: "Mico helped us understand warmth, expressiveness, and how people want to talk to AI, and these experiences are shaping the future of Copilot." The company said it would "gradually" remove Mico, and the real reason behind this is the plan to merge the Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot applications. This adjustment comes shortly after the AI department reorganization — Jacob Andreu took over Copilot, while Suleiman stepped back to focus on developing new AI models.

Although Mico has been removed before being replaced, it has not gained nothing. In less than a year, it has validated the value and boundaries of "human-like expressions" in voice interactions, and left references for Copilot's next form. When the new Copilot after the merger appears, users may face a more restrained but more unified AI assistant.

content_html_zh:
微软宣布，在副驾驶语音模式下做出表情的黄色斑点 Mico 将不再出现在聊天界面中。 根据微软支持页面，Mico 将被转移到 Learn Live 学习平台，让这个虚拟角色“有更多的内容可以做出反应”。 这一变化首先由 GeekWire 报道。

去年十月，不到一年前，Mico 在 Copilot 语音模式下推出。 当时，微软人工智能业务首席执行官穆斯塔法·苏莱曼(Mustafa Suleiman)表示，这是一种赋予聊天机器人“身份感”的尝试，这个小斑点可以根据用户对话实时制作表情和动画。 现在，它的离开将其添加到微软多年来削减的虚拟助手名单中——从回形针 Clippy，到语音助手 Cortana 和搜索狗 Rover，无一幸免。

“学”巩固，迫在眉睫

微软在其支持页面上写道：“Mico帮助我们理解了温暖、表现力以及人们想要如何与AI交谈，这些体验正在塑造Copilot的未来。” 该公司表示将“逐步”删除 Mico，其背后的真正原因是计划合并 Copilot 和 Microsoft 365 Copilot 应用程序。 这一调整是在人工智能部门重组后不久进行的——雅各布·安德鲁(Jacob Andreu)接管了Copilot，而苏莱曼(Suleiman)则退后专注于开发新的人工智能模型。

虽然Mico在被取代之前就已经被移除，但也没有收获什么。 不到一年的时间，它验证了“类人表情”在语音交互中的价值和边界，为Copilot的下一个形态留下了参考。 当合并后的新Copilot出现时，用户可能会面对一个更加克制但更加统一的AI助手。
